items.title: Clay Jenkins interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, March 18, 2016
items.q: Oh man I’m a huge fan of Nat Adderley.

ctx.x: Oh I can’t believe you said that.

I mean Nat — Nat’s all over that thing. Nat Adderley is one of the most underrated trumpet players. He was so funky and swinging and he had great chops and a great sound. But every note was swinging. Oh man I’m a huge fan of Nat Adderley.
